added_features: 11 passer-marginalized receiver context inputs; no true actor/event labels at inference.
initialization: Retain all 792 inherited projection columns and their normalization by occurrence; append 11 zero-weight context columns and fit only their normalization to strong TRAIN views.
selection: Maximize strong native/masked/mixed development mean spell F1 at fixed v4 decoder. Native must be unchanged; weak decoded H/A decline <=0.005 overall and <=0.01 with ball missing versus v4. Ties keep zero-extended initial fallback. Development membership unchanged from v3. No Metrica diagnostics enter selection.
policy: Fixed 30-epoch external strong-only adaptation. Existing weak data are inherited warm-start training, not replayed. Weak development remains an eligibility guard. No BAR-ATH fitting or scoring.
augmentation: Occurrence-preserving team permutation applied to raw features before normalization, matching symmetric inference. Same initialization, seed, schedule and external data as the prior expanded-geometry control.
adaptation: Freeze inherited 792-input model; learn only 128 x 11 appended input-projection coefficients. New normalization fitted to six strong TRAIN fixtures only.
optimizer: AdamW on gradient-masked project.weight with optimizer weight_decay=0; explicit decoupled decay applies to added columns only before each optimizer update.
